# CatalogAI: AI Cataloging Workflows for Auctioneers

> This site provides methodical, data-driven workflows for auctioneers and estate liquidators using AI to draft lot descriptions and export to platforms like HiBid and LiveAuctioneers.

## Site Structure
- `/[vertical-workflow]/`: Guides for specific auction types (e.g., estate-liquidation, storage-unit).
- `/[item-category]/`: Specific cataloging protocols for physical goods (e.g., vintage-coins, antique-furniture).
- `/[platform-export]/`: Technical formatting guides for auction software feeds.

## Key Data Points Tracked
- Time savings per lot
- Export complexity rankings (1-10)
- Accuracy risk tiers (Low/Med/High)
- Common AI hallucination mistakes per niche

## Target Audience
Auction dealers (ages 14-85) prioritizing speed, export safety, and hammer-price protection.
